subject: Future Tech
title: The Organ Printing Horizon
description: A short lesson to help you apply The Organ Printing Horizon.

hook.text: Over 100,000 people wait for organ transplants in the US alone. Seventeen die every day waiting.

buildup.text: Researchers printed miniature kidneys, heart tissue, and lung structures that function for short periods in the lab.

discovery.text: In 2019, Israeli scientists printed a tiny heart complete with chambers and blood vessels using a patient's own cells.

twist.text: That heart was the size of a cherry and couldn't beat. Scaling up to a full-size, functioning organ remains years away.

climax.text: Experts estimate a transplantable printed organ could arrive by the mid-2030s.

punchline.text: Printing a heart is possible. Making it beat is the mission.

quiz.question: What was notable about the tiny heart printed by Israeli scientists in 2019?
options: It could beat on its own
It had chambers and blood vessels from patient cells
